params.name: partner
params.description: The partner identification code issued by Dailyhunt at onboarding.

params.name: langCode
params.description: Content language code — one of en, hi, mr, gu, pa, bn, kn, ta, te, ml, or, ur, bh, ne.

params.name: ts
params.description: Current client timestamp in milliseconds; must be included in the signed parameter set.

params.name: puid
params.description: The partner's unique id for the end user accessing the API (for example a device identifier). Dailyhunt maps it to an internal user id to personalize the feed.

params.name: pfm
params.description: Partner feature mask — the sum of the feature bits enabled for the partner or channel. LIVE_TV_CARD 1, CRICKET_CARD (brief) 8, HERO_CARD 16, VIDEO_CHANNELS 32, VIRAL_CHANNELS 64, CRICKET_CARD (detailed) 128. Bits 2 and 4 are reserved.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of records per page.

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Zero-based page number of the paginated response.

items.docs: Returns the list of content channels the partner is entitled to consume for a language. A channel has a name and a `contentUrl` used to fetch its cards. Setting `pfm=64` returns the DailyShare (viral) channels instead of the standard news channels.

items.docs: Returns location-scoped channels whose items are specific to a geography. Dailyhunt must enable these channels for the partner and the correct `pfm` value must be sent. Location channels may carry `subChannels`.
